subject: maths
title: Year 9 Maths summary and memory tips

lines.say: Significant figures start at the first non-zero digit.
Increase by r percent? Multiply by 1 plus r over 100.
Simple interest adds the same amount every year.

draw.alt: Simple interest: equal blocks added each year

lines.say: Compound interest multiplies. The interest earns interest too.
2000 dollars at 5 percent for 2 years grows to 2205 dollars.
Simple adds, compound multiplies.
Expanding means multiply every term inside the bracket.
To solve, do the same to both sides.
Take 6 cubes off both sides. Then one bag off both. One bag balances 4.
Inequalities. Multiply or divide by a negative, and flip the sign.
Factorise first, then cancel factors. Never cancel across a plus.
Longest side? Add the squares. Shorter side? Subtract.
Label opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse from the angle.
x is opposite 30 degrees, and 10 is the hypotenuse. So use sine.
lines.alt: Right-angled triangle with hypotenuse 10 cm, angle 30° and opposite side x

lines.say: Elevation and depression are both measured from the horizontal.
Gradient is rise over run.
In y equals m x plus c, m is the gradient and c is the y-intercept.
lines.alt: The line y = 3x − 1 crossing the y-axis at −1

lines.say: m for mountain, c for crossing.
Parallel lines have equal gradients. Perpendicular gradients multiply to minus 1.
Cherry pie is delicious. Apple pies are too.
Prism volume is area of the end times length.
Times, add the indices. Divide, subtract. Bracket, multiply.
A negative index means one over. 2 to the minus 3 is an eighth.
For surds, find the biggest square inside.

draw.alt: Root 72 split into root 36 times root 2; root 36 becomes 6

lines.say: Angles on a line add to 180. In a triangle, also 180.
Similar shapes. Lengths times k, areas times k squared.
A 1.8 metre person casts a 1.2 metre shadow. A tree casts 6 metres.

draw.alt: Small triangle for the person and a large similar triangle for the tree

lines.say: So the tree is 1.8 times 5, which is 9 metres.
Skew is named after the tail, not the bunch.
Range is max minus min. IQR is Q3 minus Q1.
Along the branch, multiply. Between branches, add.
lines.alt: Tree diagram with P(W) = 0.3 and P(L) = 0.7 on every branch

lines.say: Simulations. Yes numbers over all numbers equals the probability.
Make one side 0, factorise, then use the null factor law.
y equals x squared minus 4 crosses at minus 2 and 2. Turning point 0, minus 4.
lines.alt: Parabola y = x² − 4 with x-intercepts −2 and 2 and turning point (0, −4)

lines.say: The bracket moves it the opposite way. x minus 2 moves right 2.
Halving method. Keep the half where the sign changes.
